description: This file defines an API router for managing accounting entries in a FastAPI web application. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving (single and paginated list), updating, and deleting accounting entries, integrating with an external accounting_service.

methods.name: create_accounting_entry(entry: AccountingEntryCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new accounting entry using data provided in the request body.

methods.name: list_accounting_entries( skip: int = Query(0, ge=0, description="Number of records to skip"), limit: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Maximum number of records to return"), transaction_type: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by transaction type (debit/credit)"), category: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by category"), account_name: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by account name") )
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of accounting entries with optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: get_accounting_entry(entry_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a specific accounting entry by its ID.

methods.name: update_accounting_entry(entry_id: int, entry: AccountingEntryUpdate)
methods.description: Updates an existing accounting entry identified by its ID with new data.

methods.name: delete_accounting_entry(entry_id: int)
methods.description: Deletes an accounting entry by its ID.

ctags.name: list_accounting_entries
